content: Blossom BUDs define publicly accessible content-addressed blob retrieval, signed auth for management, optional upload preflight, MIME and size descriptors, and status codes for size/type/rate policy. Auth tokens need expiration, verb, server, and hash scope; unscoped delete tokens are replayable. Protocol compliance alone does not supply malware scanning, legal notice handling, quarantine, content sniffing, private attachment confidentiality, or quotas.
